name: Thrizer vs SimplePractice
title: Thrizer vs SimplePractice: OON Billing Service vs Full EHR Comparison
description: Compare Thrizer (out-of-network billing service) and SimplePractice (practice management EHR). Understand how these complementary tools serve different purposes.

summary.bottom_line: Thrizer and SimplePractice serve different functions and can be used together. SimplePractice is a complete practice management EHR (scheduling, billing, notes, portal). Thrizer is a specialized out-of-network billing service that helps clients get reimbursed for OON therapy. You need an EHR like SimplePractice to run your practice; Thrizer is an add-on for OON reimbursement.

key_differences.pricing_model: Thrizer (3% of reimbursements) vs SimplePractice (monthly subscription)
key_differences.who_pays: Thrizer (clients pay fee) vs SimplePractice (provider pays)

sections.heading: Thrizer vs SimplePractice: Overview
sections.content: Thrizer and SimplePractice are not competitors—they serve different purposes. SimplePractice is a comprehensive practice management EHR: scheduling, client portal, in-network billing, documentation, and telehealth. Thrizer is a specialized service that submits out-of-network claims on behalf of clients, helping them get reimbursed from their insurance. An OON therapist might use SimplePractice to manage their practice and add Thrizer to help clients get OON reimbursements.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: SimplePractice costs $49-99/month paid by the provider for complete practice management. Thrizer charges 3% of reimbursements paid by the client (not the provider). This is key: Thrizer's fee comes from clients, not your practice. SimplePractice helps you bill in-network insurers directly; Thrizer helps your OON clients file claims and get reimbursed. They address different billing scenarios with different pricing models.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: SimplePractice provides: appointment scheduling, client intake portal, in-network insurance billing, superbills for OON clients, progress notes, telehealth, and e-prescribing. Thrizer provides: OON claim submission on clients' behalf, benefit verification, claim tracking, and Instant Pay (80-90% upfront before insurance processes). SimplePractice generates superbills for OON clients to self-file; Thrizer handles the filing for them.

recommendations.when: You're in-network and need practice management, OR you're OON and clients are comfortable self-filing superbills
You're OON and want to offer clients an easier reimbursement experience—use SimplePractice for practice management and Thrizer for OON claim submission
Never—Thrizer only handles OON billing. You still need an EHR like SimplePractice for scheduling, notes, and practice management

faqs.q: Does Thrizer replace SimplePractice for OON therapists?
faqs.a: No. Thrizer only handles OON claim submission. You still need an EHR like SimplePractice for scheduling, client management, documentation, and running your practice. Thrizer is an add-on service, not a replacement.

faqs.q: How is Thrizer different from SimplePractice's OON billing?
faqs.a: SimplePractice generates superbills that OON clients can submit themselves. Thrizer actually submits the claims for clients, tracks them, and offers Instant Pay (80-90% upfront). Thrizer removes the burden of claim filing from clients.

Clients pay Thrizer's 3% fee, not the therapist. This is different from SimplePractice where the provider pays the subscription. Thrizer's model means no additional cost to your practice for offering the service.

faqs.q: Can I use both Thrizer and SimplePractice together?
faqs.a: Yes, they complement each other well. Use SimplePractice for practice management (scheduling, notes, portal) and Thrizer to help OON clients get reimbursed without the hassle of self-filing claims.
